description: Trigger a Qlik Cloud app reload and poll it to completion, surfacing status/duration/error as materialization metadata.

outputs.description: Materializable asset for a Qlik Cloud app reload

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Dagster asset key for the Qlik Cloud app.

app_id.label: App Id
app_id.description: Qlik Cloud app id to reload.

tenant_url_env_var.label: Tenant Url Env Var
tenant_url_env_var.description: Env var holding the tenant base URL, e.g. https://my-tenant.us.qlikcloud.com (Qlik Cloud is tenant-scoped -- there is no shared hostname).

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding a Qlik Cloud API key (Bearer token -- see qlik.dev's 'generate your first API key').

partial.label: Partial
partial.description: Partial reload instead of a full reload.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the reload to reach a terminal status before failing the run.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys (e.g. the warehouse fact table this app reads).

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: If true, adds a sensor that polls GET /api/v1/reloads?appId=... for reloads this component did NOT trigger (e.g. a scheduled reload configured in Qlik Cloud itself, or someone reloading from the Qlik hub), and emits AssetObservation for each one -- distinguished from this asset's own triggers via the resourceId tag ('dagster') set on every reload this component starts. Off by default.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{asset_key}__reload_observer'. Only used when polling_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between sensor polls. Only used when polling_sensor=True.

name: QlikCloudAppReload
